title: Extraction output for one source document
description: One file per source document, named <document_id>.json. Field ids come from the field catalog; every catalog field appears in every case.

document_id.description: File name of the source document without extension, e.g. D01

model.description: Provider and model that produced this output, written as provider/model

flags.description: Document-level observations. Recommended values: no_adverse_event, multiple_patients, unsupported_format, possible_duplicate. Free text is allowed for anything else you want a reviewer to know about the document.

cases.description: One entry per patient who experienced a reaction described in the document. Empty when the document reports no adverse event.

label.description: Short human label for the UI, e.g. 'Mother' or 'Infant'

value.description: Required when status is extracted. Type follows the catalog: string, integer, number, ISO date string, option code, array of option codes, or array of strings.

confidence.description: Required when status is extracted. Absent confidence is scored as high.

provenance.description: Required when status is extracted. Where in the document the value comes from.

note.description: Free text. For conflict, list the candidate values seen.

quote.description: The exact text from the document that supports the value. Copied, not paraphrased.

start.description: Character offset of the quote in the .txt file, 0-based, inclusive. Offsets count Unicode code points in the UTF-8 decoded file.

end.description: Character offset, exclusive. text[start:end] must be the quote; the checker ignores case and runs of whitespace.

page.description: Optional. Page number when the document has page markers.
